# KeyOne — Keywan Fakhri

> KeyOne is the personal product studio of Keywan Fakhri (Rahmatallah Fakhri Fakhrabadi), an industrial engineer (M.Sc. Wirtschaftsingenieur) based in Konstanz, Germany, with 8+ years of experience in logistics, warehouse management and inventory optimization. He builds practical tools that connect process engineering with data, software and AI – for companies, warehouses, restaurants and cafés.

The website is available in 12 languages (de, en, fa, ar, tr, it, fr, ko, zh, ja, es, sq) via the `?lang=` parameter.

## Free Excel templates
- [Excel templates overview](https://keywanfakhri.com/templates/?lang=en): free downloadable dashboards for warehouse, operations reporting and restaurants, free for internal use.
- [Warehouse Intelligence](https://keywanfakhri.com/templates/?lang=en#warehouse-intelligence): warehouse KPI dashboard in Excel – on-time delivery, picking accuracy, delay root causes (Pareto), order status and activity heatmap. 12 languages switchable inside Excel, up to 2,000 orders, protected formulas, no macros. Direct download: https://keywanfakhri.com/templates/files/KeyOne_Warehouse_Intelligence.xlsx
- [Executive Reporting Center](https://keywanfakhri.com/templates/?lang=en#executive-reporting-center): multi-year operations reporting in Excel – daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly views, comparison with base year and targets by department, monthly heatmap, year-over-year comparison, statistics and a one-page management report. 12 languages, up to 10,000 rows. Direct download: https://keywanfakhri.com/templates/files/KeyOne_Executive_Reporting_Center.xlsx
- [Restaurant Profit Analyzer](https://keywanfakhri.com/templates/?lang=en#restaurant-profit-analyzer): restaurant food cost and menu engineering in Excel – ingredient prices with yield, recipe costing, food cost percentage and gross profit per dish, automatic Star/Plowhorse/Puzzle/Dog classification, year-over-year comparison, top 10 dishes, sales by weekday and a one-page report. 12 languages, up to 20,000 sales rows, no macros.
- [Cash Flow Planner](https://keywanfakhri.com/templates/?lang=en#cash-flow-planner): 13-week cash forecast and 12-month cash plan in Excel for small businesses – recurring payments, actual vs planned transactions, safety buffer warning, category breakdown. 12 languages, up to 10,000 transactions, no macros.

- [Warehouse Intelligence – details, KPI formulas and FAQ](https://keywanfakhri.com/templates/warehouse-intelligence/?lang=en)
- [Executive Reporting Center – details, KPI formulas and FAQ](https://keywanfakhri.com/templates/executive-reporting-center/?lang=en)
- [Restaurant Profit Analyzer – details, KPI formulas and FAQ](https://keywanfakhri.com/templates/restaurant-profit-analyzer/?lang=en)
- [Cash Flow Planner – details, KPI formulas and FAQ](https://keywanfakhri.com/templates/cash-flow-planner/?lang=en)

## Guides
- [How to calculate food cost (restaurants)](https://keywanfakhri.com/guides/wareneinsatz-berechnen/?lang=en): formula, worked example, per-dish costing with yield, price from target food cost, benchmarks (German original: https://keywanfakhri.com/guides/wareneinsatz-berechnen/).
- [Menu engineering in Excel](https://keywanfakhri.com/guides/menu-engineering-excel/?lang=en): Kasavana & Smith matrix step by step – popularity threshold, weighted contribution margin, Excel formula, example with seven dishes and actions per class (German original: https://keywanfakhri.com/guides/menu-engineering-excel/).
- [Articles (overview)](https://keywanfakhri.com/guides/?lang=en): all practical articles on warehousing, logistics and Excel reporting.
- [Warehouse KPIs: the 10 most important metrics with formulas](https://keywanfakhri.com/guides/warehouse-kpis/?lang=en): on-time delivery, perfect order rate, picking accuracy, picking productivity, inventory turnover, days of supply, inventory accuracy, order cycle time, storage utilization, cost per order – with formulas and practical tips (German original: https://keywanfakhri.com/guides/warehouse-kpis/).

## Logistics & process engineering tools
- [Lagerplaner 2D/3D](https://keywanfakhri.com/projects/lagerplaner/?lang=en): free online warehouse planner – enter items and get storage technology, area, staff, forklifts and equipment with a 2D plan and 3D model.
- [Logistics dashboard – KPI demo](https://keywanfakhri.com/projects/logistics/?lang=en): interactive demo with fifteen logistics KPIs, targets and monthly trends (simulated data).
- [Prozessatlas](https://keywanfakhri.com/projects/prozessatlas/?lang=en): process atlas linking business processes and KPIs.

## Hospitality
- [Smart restaurant solutions](https://keywanfakhri.com/projects/restaurant/?lang=en): digital solutions for cafés and restaurants – communication, menu, orders and administration.
- [Gastlyo](https://keywanfakhri.com/gastlyo/): digital menu with AI waiter in 12 languages.

## Services & prices

Konstanz region and online; projects from December 2026.
